scientific_question: Can each Wave-1 implementation be treated as deterministic under the exact 128k local WMA stack, allowing one rather than three full-split runs?
decision_only: execution multiplicity; this gate cannot support benchmark accuracy, ranking, or SOTA claims

previously_observed_evidence.observed_runs: one earlier 32k development smoke for all four methods
previously_observed_evidence.influence: the sample remains fixed because it was selected from cost metadata before outputs; earlier scores are not used by this gate

decision_rule.deterministic: all three combined semantic SHA-256 digests match exactly for the method
decision_rule.no_cross_method_rule: classification is method-specific; one deterministic method does not exempt another

included: judge labels and metric-bearing evaluation fields

failure_and_recovery.unit_failure: seal that unit as TERMINAL_REJECTED and reject the gate; no in-place resume
failure_and_recovery.gate_failure: preserve the complete gate root; a recovery requires a new prefreeze and fresh root
failure_and_recovery.service_cleanup: stop only the three project-owned tmux sessions recorded by this gate

prohibited_actions: writing any gate score into comparisons/reproduced-results.v1.csv
changing the sample, method order, evaluator, or digest fields after observing a replicate
reusing or editing a failed unit directory
stopping or inspecting another user's processes beyond aggregate resource checks
